remarks: This is a rare opportunity to live on a highly sought after cul de sac in the Village of Lancaster.  This property features 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths.  The primary bedroom has direct access to the shared bathroom on the 2nd floor.  This bathroom has a tub/shower, plus a separate walk in shower.  There is ample closet space in each bedroom.  The west facing bedroom provides access through the closet into a large lighted storage space.  The living room has a spacious vaulted ceiling.  The vaulted living room has a gas insert fireplace for cozy times.  The kitchen has granite counters & flows into the dining/eating area.  There is a counter for stools.  A feature built in wood shelving area  graces the dining area, perfect for displays.  The dining area overlooks the gunnite pool with beautifully landscaped backyard.  Tree lined  and completely fenced in.  The step down family room is off the open dining area.  This leads to a 3 season room with windows on all sides.  Enjoy the gunnite pool with hot tub.  An added feature is the barn/garage on the property.  The separate electrified, heated by wood barn has a loft for storage & double wide garage door.  Great for any project you have!  Plenty of storage for vehicles, lawn equipment, seasonal gear.  An additional feature in the bilco basement door for easily moving in and out items, without going through your home.  Enjoy peace of mind with the whole house generator.  Combo Wall Hung Boiler & Hot Water Unit installed in 2023.  Totally fenced in yard with a gate that allows easy entrance to the backyard, pool & barn.  The landscaped front yard welcomes you home to this cared for, move-in home!  Sold as is.  Showings for this move-in ready home start immediately, 10/12/2026.  Offers are due at 12PM, Wednesday, October 28, 2026.  OPEN HOUSE on Saturday, October 17, 2026 from 12-3PM
